items.question: What does Kizora sell?
items.answer: Kizora specialises in everyday-carry gear: backpacks, laptop backpacks, school and kids’ trolley bags, water bottles, thermos flasks, and accessories.

items.question: Do you offer delivery?
items.answer: Yes, we deliver nationwide across Bangladesh. A standard delivery charge applies, and orders above ৳3,000 ship free.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD) as well as bKash, Nagad and card payments via SSLCommerz at checkout.

items.question: Is there a warranty on Kizora products?
items.answer: Yes — every Kizora product comes with a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship.

items.question: What is your return policy?
items.answer: Unused items in original condition and packaging can be returned within 7 days of delivery. See our Terms for full details.

items.question: Are your water bottles and flasks leak-proof?
items.answer: Our bottles are designed to be leak-proof, and our flasks use double-wall vacuum insulation that keeps drinks hot or cold for hours.

items.question: Do you offer bulk or wholesale orders?
items.answer: Yes. We offer bulk pricing and optional custom branding for offices, schools and events — reach out via our Contact page.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: After placing your order you’ll receive an order number. Use our Track Order page any time to check its current status.
